findings.summary: Normalization is applied to exactly the wrong subset of lifts — legacy lifts missing `method` are left un-normalized.
findings.mechanism: `snapshot.lifts.map(lift => lift.method ? normalizeLift(lift) : lift)` only calls `normalizeLift` when `lift.method` is already truthy, and passes legacy lifts (no `method`, e.g. v1 exports) through unchanged. But `normalizeLift`'s entire purpose (per src/domain/methods/normalize.ts) is to derive a default `{ kind: 'linear', ... }` method for exactly those lifts lacking one; when `lift.method` is already set it just re-wraps it via `parseMethod`. The condition is inverted: legacy/pre-method lifts — the case the task explicitly calls out — get bulkAdded to the DB with `method` still undefined, while already-normalized v2 lifts get redundantly reprocessed. This defeats the stated goal of producing a 'consistent, fully-populated shape after import' for older exports.
